_note: Step 12 v2 streaming service. ASR/LLM/ref/persona from config/voice.json; TTS quality settings identical to the benchmark (docs/perf_tts_fast.md).

resample.library: soxr ResampleStream (stateful, one resampler per utterance)

llm_to_tts._note: mode 'full' (default): TTS starts when the LLM reply is complete - measured faster on this machine (avatar speaking start mean 3.07 s vs 3.29 s for 'sentence', because TTS and llama.cpp share the GPU while the LLM is still generating) and keeps whole-utterance prosody. 'sentence' remains selectable per request (?mode=sentence).
